footer.tagline: A small catalog ready for real products.

sections.title: Three offers to replace with the real catalog
sections.body: Edit this seed locally before setting up auth or a production checkout.

items.title: {{BRAND}} Starter
items.body: A simple entry offer. USD 29.00; replace this copy and price with a real product.

items.title: {{BRAND}} Plus
items.body: A broader option for customers who need more. USD 59.00; no checkout is implied.

items.title: {{BRAND}} Complete
items.body: The highest starter tier for comparing demand. USD 99.00; connect payment only when requested.

sections.title: Start with a catalog and one clear intent path
sections.body: This transaction shape deliberately stops before cart, payment, inventory, and accounts.

items.title: Shape the offer
items.body: Replace the seed products and homepage cards with the first real catalog.

items.title: Validate demand
items.body: Add a lightweight inquiry flow only when the owner wants to collect purchase intent.

items.title: Choose checkout later
items.body: Select a payment provider after the public product surface is useful.

items.title: Can I edit this without GitHub OAuth?
items.body: Yes. Edit this seed for the local first page; Staff MCP becomes the authoring path after auth is configured.

items.title: Is checkout already enabled?
items.body: No. The starter avoids fake payment claims and keeps checkout as an explicit next decision.

items.title: Where does the product model live?
items.body: The products Schema and public-products View live in manifests/site.yaml.

sections.title: Turn this seed into the real {{BRAND}} catalog
sections.body: Replace the three products, refine the visual direction, then decide whether inquiry or checkout is the next useful workflow.
